155: A person is obligated to study every day: the Written Torah (that is, Tanakh), as well as Mishnah, Gemara, and the legal decisors (poskim). Laypeople (ba’alei batim) who only study three or four hours a day should not study only Gemara, because with that alone they do not fulfill their obligation. Rather, they must specifically also study works of the poskim, each according to their level of understanding. [Shulchan Aruch, Yoreh De’ah, and the Shach there]
